name: Envestnet Tamarac
description:
Envestnet Tamarac brings planning, portfolio management, trading, reporting, and client engagement together in one connected experience, reducing operational friction and giving RIAs a return on their advisor's day.
This connector gives Claude read-only access to select Tamarac data an advisor is already entitled to see, so they can ask questions in plain language.
Claude can search for clients, households and accounts by name, then provide a summary of select data points.
Useful for researching account information, preparing meeting materials, or analyzing clients and reports across your business.
If you are interested in connecting with Claude, please reach out to our Tamarac service team at TamaracSupport@envestnet.com to initiate the process.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Envestnet Tamarac to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Envestnet Tamarac to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://envestnet.io/mcp/tamarac. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Envestnet Tamarac MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Envestnet Tamarac provides these MCP tools: mcp-tamarac___getAccount, mcp-tamarac___getAccountValues, mcp-tamarac___getAccountsByQuery, mcp-tamarac___getAllAccountsValues, mcp-tamarac___getClient, mcp-tamarac___getClientsByQuery, mcp-tamarac___getHoldingsByHousehold, mcp-tamarac___getHouseholdDetails, and mcp-tamarac___getHouseholdsByQuery.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Envestnet Tamarac?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Envestnet Tamarac in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Envestnet Tamarac MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Envestnet Tamarac requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Envestnet Tamarac is developed by Envestnet. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
